description: This file provides a JSON helper class with methods for serialization, attribute management, and string conversion, along with utility functions for parsing strings into Python data types and booleans.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: A class for managing JSON data with custom serialization and attribute handling.

methods.name: convert_string
methods.description: Converts a string to int, float, boolean, or returns the string if parsing fails.

methods.name: boolean
methods.description: Converts a string to a boolean value based on case-insensitive matching.
